['DKV Mobility Services Group '].company_description: DKV Mobility Services Group is Europe's market leader for cash-free service en route, providing smart solutions for goods and passenger road transport. Their products include the DKV CARD, which offers access to the largest supply network in the industry. The company has a history of almost 90 years of purpose-driven growth, constantly adapting products and business models to evolving customer needs. They service around 314,000 active customers in more than 50 service countries across Europe.

['Bosch Rexroth AG '].company_description: Bosch Rexroth AG is an engineering firm based in Lohr am Main in Germany. It is a wholly owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH and employs over 31,000 people worldwide. The company operates in the areas of automation technology, drive and control technology, and industrial hydraulics, offering products such as electric drives and controls, gear technology, linear motion technology, assembly technology, and hydraulic systems.
